title: STP Pilot Plant
author: MR. G.J. Simmons
narrative: Special Tobacco Products Pilot Plant Facilities
note: Any additions or changes in scope will be transmitted as addendums to this Narrative
scope: It is proposed to equip a new pilot plant facility in the R&D complex for Specialty Tobacco Products. The pilot operation is to produce test products for both current and new new brands of smoking tobaccos, chewing tobaccos, and wet snuff.
processFlowDescription: The process flow diagram (see Attachment I) describes the proposed flow lines for a new facility. The proposed operation is described as follows: Strip blends may be obtained from Factory No. 8 or No. 60 Blending, or may be blended in the Pilot Plant. The blending system begins with two 500 lb (max) feeders (normal 250 lb/hr rate) each
